data.body:
Live Bedrock experiment TRANSCRIPT (verbatim stdout), AWS us-east-1, model bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6. Driver drove CompletionAgentStep._recover over a synthetic 3-criterion ticket: the primary run and the FIRST criterion's evidence run were forced to raise LLMBudgetExhaustedError; the remaining 2 evidence runs and the tool-free finalizer executed LIVE against Bedrock.

=== ed6d LIVE recovery result ===
primary exhaustions: 0        (precondition injected directly into _recover)
evidence runs total: 3 (1 forced-exhausted, live: 2 )
finalizer live calls: 1
verdict keys: ['_usage', 'criteria', 'findings', 'model', 'provider_provenance', 'runner', 'summary', 'trace_id', 'verdict']
verdict: FAIL
verdict criteria count: 3
STEP STATUS: succeeded

Interpretation: recovery COMPLETED WITH A VERDICT (StepResult.status=succeeded; a completion_verdict with 3 criteria entries) despite one evidence run exhausting — it did NOT raise CompletionRecoveryError and fail whole. The verdict is FAIL because the exhausted criterion carries the content-free could-not-gather-within-bounds placeholder that cannot be read as affirmative. This is the exhaustion-is-not-a-verdict trap being closed with partial-evidence preservation.

Independent production corroboration: BOTH the 8eb3 close and this ed6d close ran the LIVE completion verifier whose PRIMARY agentic run hit a real runaway tool-call loop (8eb3: requests=97/tool_calls=112/repeat=12; ed6d: requests=87/tool_calls=92) that the c827 loop-breaker aborted, after which THIS recovery path took over and produced a structured verdict end-to-end against Bedrock.
